instruction.text: Read the fairytale and answer the questions.

atoms.text:
Once upon a time, a mother duck lived by a lake.

She was very excited, because she had seven eggs and was expecting seven beautiful little yellow ducklings. Six beautiful little yellow ducklings hatched from the eggs, and the mother duck quacked proudly.

A few days later, a grey, ugly duckling hatched from the last egg.

The mother duck was worried, because he was such an ugly duckling.

None of the other ducks wanted to spend much time with him. That made the ugly duckling very sad.

atoms.a: Why was one of the ducklings treated differently to the others?

instruction.text: Read the fairytale and answer the questions.

atoms.text:
One day the ugly duckling decided to run away and find his happiness elsewhere.

He had many adventures and met many people and animals, but nobody could tell him why he was so ugly.

After several months it became winter, and the duckling almost froze to death. But a farmer found him and nursed him until the following spring.

One glorious sunny day, he took the duckling to a beautiful lake.

instruction.text: Read the fairytale and answer the questions.

atoms.text:
On the surface of the water, the duckling saw his reflection for the first time in a long time.

He suddenly saw that he was no longer ugly at all!

He had beautiful white plumage and a slender neck. Then, he realised that he had never been a duckling, but rather a beautiful swan.

From then on, the no-longer-ugly duckling lived the rest of his life happily and peacefully together with the other swans.

b: ++He realised that he was actually a swan.
He realised that he was actually a beautiful duck.
He realised that he was still ugly.

atoms.a: What’s the main message of the story?
b: ++don’t judge a book by its cover.
